title: The bird on the corn, the last
logline: The twenty-ninth corn, the tray shared, two forks — and the bird on the rim between the forks. The third time, and the last corn the book takes. Nobody moves it.

panels.composition: From above: a paper tray of corn on a counter with two forks, a heavy hand and a thin hand reaching from opposite sides, and the small rainbow bird on the tray's rim between the forks.

image.prompt: a single full comic page with no panel borders, spare knowing ink line with economy, muted ochre and slate blue and sea-foam green washes, seen from above, a paper tray of buttered corn on a shop counter with two forks and a heavy hand and a thin hand reaching from opposite sides, a small rainbow bird perched on the tray's rim between the forks, no words

art.line: spare, knowing; economy of line; Era I's black spotting back on purpose in the mill run
art.palette: muted ochres, slate blues, misty sea-foam greens; luminous sunbreaks in the last spring
art.paper: Arches; bristol; the backs of motel registration cards

notes: Third and last. Nobody moves it.
